title: feat(formatNumber): add formatNumber helper

comments.body:
Deploy preview for *algolia-instantsearch* ready!

Built with commit 94514e6c6ef3435b9820ca5f87ed0f108c05a7b0

https://deploy-preview-3141--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com
What's the use case for this in JS (I understand the use in string templates, since they don't have regular JS)

In the string template, you cannot set the `numberLocale`.

This is a wrapper over [`Number.prototype.toLocaleString()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Number/toLocaleString). I thought we would expose all helpers in there.
Note that I will move all helpers on `instantsearch.helpers` or something (instead of the `instantsearch` object).
